product.olivetti-m70-2.summary: The 2-CPU version of the Linea 1 M70.
product.olivetti-m70-2.history: The Historical Archive dates the M70 to 1986 as a high-end system for organisations with more workstations.
product.olivetti-m70-2.architecture: The system bus supported double-height boards. The documented UC071 has a 10 MHz Z8001B and 8 KB of cache.
product.olivetti-m70-2.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-m70-2.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-m70-2.archive: Associazione Archivio Storico Olivetti, L1: una nuova linea di sistemi informatici.
